title: California RSU Tax for Non-Residents: Complete Sourcing Rules Guide (2026)
description: Definitive guide to California's aggressive RSU sourcing rules for non-residents. Learn the allocation formula, Form 540NR filing requirements, and strategies that save $15,000-$50,000 annually on stock compensation after leaving California.
content:
## Quick Answer: California Non-Resident RSU Tax

**California WILL tax your RSUs even after you leave** if you earned them while a CA resident.

**Sourcing formula:**
(CA work days from grant to vest / Total work days from grant to vest) × RSU value

**Tax rate:** 1-13.3% (same as residents)

**Filing:** Form 540NR (CA non-resident return)

**Example:** Worked in SF 2022-2024, moved to Texas 2025. When $100K RSUs vest in 2026, California claims 50% ($50K) and taxes it at 13.3% = $6,650 owed.
